name: newshp-13
summary: Brown ground turret, a small armoured tank seen from above, here aiming up-left (the model turns to eight directions). A grey hard-surface hull with a chunky armoured track pod down each side, two short prongs reaching forward either side of the gun, a notch at the back holding a red lamp, and on the hull a bronze-brown armoured turret dome on a dark ring with a long gun: a grey round sleeve and a brown muzzle block. Flat chamfered armour everywhere except the round dome and the round gun.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: bronze-brown (palette 20-26) turret block centred at cols 11-15, rows 11-14, the brightest, highest part of the hull
rounded armoured dome: rounded-rect footprint about 5 px across, rising well above the hull deck (about 3 px), lit upper-left by the light, not painted
sits on a dark ring/skirt (163 at col 14 row 14, the dark gap at row 15)
features.note: Baseline: a low flat-topped loft about 1 px above the plate. The concept draws a tall segmented bronze dome; it should read as the turret, the tallest round part.

traits: single round barrel running up-left out of the dome's front (pixels 6/9/5 along the diagonal cols 8-10, rows 7-9)
grey sleeve, constant diameter about 1.5 px, a cylinder not a slab
raised clear of the hull at dome mid-height, with a mantlet block where it leaves the dome
features.note: Baseline gun is a thin tube at 2 px height that stops short of the sprite's muzzle.

traits: brown (24/22) muzzle block at the gun's tip, cols 5-7, rows 4-6
slightly wider than the sleeve, with a dark neck between them (the concept's muzzle brake)
reaches the sprite's tip at col 5 row 5
features.note: Baseline muzzle is a tapered brown tube that ends about 1.5 px short.

traits: long armoured pod down the hull's left side (grey 3-8 band from cols 5-9 rows 10-14 down to cols 9-13 rows 16-18)
boxy with chamfered top edges, standing above the centre deck (the sprite's lit band along it)
its front end is the left prong reaching forward beside the gun (cols 5-9, rows 9-13)
features.note: Baseline: a 1 px plate; the diagonal frame's base sat about 1 px too far right of the sprite so this side was missing.

traits: long armoured pod down the hull's right side (cols 15-18, rows 10-16, grey 4-7)
same height and chamfered profile as the left pod (its darker shade is the light, not paint)
two short blocks reaching forward either side of the gun (right one at cols 11-13 rows 7-9, left one at cols 6-9 rows 10-13)
about 2 px wide, chamfered front, a little lower than the pods
a dark gap between each prong and the gun
features.note: Baseline has them as 1 px tall plates.

traits: small red (116) glowing lamp at col 15 row 16, behind the dome toward the hull's back
emissive, set in a dark housing in the rear notch between the pod ends
features.note: Baseline: a red tile flat on the plate.

traits: the hull's back has a notch between the two pods' rear ends (dark 1-2 pixels at cols 14-17 rows 15-17)
cut into the deck, lower than the pods, holding the lamp housing
features.note: Clearest in the up frame (row 18: lobes at cols 7-9 and 13-14, notch at 10-12); the concept draws the red light between two rear fender blocks.
